decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: Monday to Sunday, 9.00am to 23.00pm and all customers shall have left the premises by 23.30pm .

Condition : 2 - No amplified or any other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times: Monday to Sunday, 9.00am to 23.00pm and when played, shall be inaudible from the nearest residential property.
Condition : 3 - The outdoor seating area shall be not be used outside the following times: 9.00am to 22.00pm and cleared away by 22.30pm.
description: Variation of Condition 4 of planning permission 00609/BH(U14)/P3 for the change of use from A1 (Retail) to A3 (Restaurant) for the use of the premises as a coffee shop dated 05/07/2006 to alter permitted opening times from Monday to Saturday, 9.00am-17.30pm and on Sunday 9.00am-16.00pm to Monday to Sunday, 9.00am-23.00pm
